            j=i
            sig=line
            while j < len(lines) and '{' not in sig and j-start < 12:

                if j < len(lines): sig += ' ' + lines[j]

                        if ch=='{': depth+=1; begun=True
                        elif ch=='}' and begun: depth-=1

                    m=re.search(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(', sig)

        i+=1

            print(f'{p}:{n}: {s[:180]}')
print('=== TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX ===')
for p in list(Path('.').rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.parts and p.stat().st_size < 1000000:
        try: txt=p.read_text()
        except Exception: continue
        for n,line in enumerate(txt.splitlines(),1):
            if re.search(r'\b(TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX)\b',line,re.I): print(f'{p}:{n}: {line.strip()[:200]}')
